Thanks Nina — looping in Laura and Jonas for the SLA/exec framing.

Short update: we've reworked the dashboard so the top-row tiles show 3-week trend, and we've added a small 'driver' column that calls out whether the signal is cache-hit ratio, model size, or infra (GPU queuing). Preliminary findings:
- Latency: p95 +120ms for text-generation routes (largely traceable to increased batch sizes during peak).
- Cost: per-1k-token down 8% month-over-month after a caching tweak, but burst costs during the 03:00–05:00 UTC window remain elevated.
- Uptime: 99.95% last 30 days; small maintenance windows on 10/03 and 10/11 account for most of the delta.

Attached the revised dashboard export (PDF) and a short CSV with the latency-by-route breakdown you asked for.

Ask: Nina — can your team confirm whether cached responses are acceptable to show in QBR slides (they reduce unit cost but may obscure tail-latency for cold requests)?

-Jasmine
